# Code Anchors: Distill Command

- `libs/portable-tools/src/distill-command.ts` — the command: the target forms (epic number or pull request), the ordered pre-start checks, the live-run check keyed by epic number, the re-run hints in the form the lead used, the cleanup line in every ending, the permission-mode line, the session start in the close worktree, the platform check that decides the outcome, and the detached background runner with its status lines.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/distill-command.spec.ts` — pins every refusal, the epic and bare-number forms, the one-run-per-epic refusal, the platform-read outcome rule, the marker, the fixed prompt, both harnesses and the background run.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — registers the distill verb, its epic, bare-number and pull-request targets, and the cleanup subcommand on the shared executable.
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/close-command.ts` — close's pull-request-to-epic resolution, and its issues-repository resolution, exported so this command resolves an epic exactly as close does.
- `README.md` — the adopter-facing usage of the command, its permission default and its cleanup command.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/distill-exceptional-paths.spec.ts` — pins the stopped and unconfirmed endings, each naming the cleanup command.
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/worktree.ts` — the distillation-branch naming rule by epic number that both the start command and cleanup match against.
